Landing.faq1Q: Does my team need to install anything?
Landing.faq1A: No. They reply over email or WhatsApp, the channel they already use. Nobody creates an account or logs into any dashboard.
Landing.faq2Q: What happens to my team's data?

Landing.faq3Q: Do I need a card to try it?
Landing.faq3A: Yes, but you won't be charged for the first 30 days. Cancel before then and you pay nothing.
Landing.faq4Q: Can I change plans or cancel anytime?
Landing.faq4A: Yes, no commitment. You do it yourself from your dashboard, anytime.
Landing.faq5A: Yes, the interface and reports are generated in native Spanish — or English, if you prefer.
Landing.faq6Q: What if I need more than 5 teams, or something custom?
Landing.faq6A: There's a Custom plan with no limit on teams or people, priced to fit. Email contact@weeklyfeedback.com and let's talk.

termsSections.heading: 1. Purpose
termsSections.body: These terms govern access to and use of WeeklyFeedback, a SaaS service that collects weekly replies from team members (over Telegram or email) and generates a narrative report using AI for the team's lead.

termsSections.heading: 2. Service provider
termsSections.body: WeeklyFeedback is provided by Javier Abad, as a sole trader (autónomo), tax ID 545563340r, registered address at c/ Uria nº8 2ºa, 33202, Oviedo, Spain. Contact: contact@weeklyfeedback.com.

termsSections.heading: 3. Account and access
termsSections.body: Accessing the dashboard requires registering with an email and password. The account holder is responsible for keeping their credentials confidential and for activity under their account. Team members who reply over Telegram or email don't create an account and have no access to the dashboard.

termsSections.heading: 4. Plans, pricing and billing
termsSections.body: Current prices (Team plan €49/mo, Organization plan €149/mo, excluding VAT) are shown on the pricing page. The subscription is managed through Stripe, includes a 30-day free trial with a card on file from signup, and renews automatically each month unless canceled. There's no lock-in: you can cancel anytime from your dashboard, effective at the end of the period already paid for.

termsSections.heading: 5. Use of the service
termsSections.body: You agree to use the service lawfully, to only enter data you have the right to process, and not to use the service for purposes other than legitimately managing your own work team.

termsSections.heading: 6. Intellectual property
termsSections.body: The software, the WeeklyFeedback brand and site materials belong to the provider. Data you enter (team replies, company context) remains yours.

termsSections.heading: 7. Availability and liability
termsSections.body: The service is provided "as is", without a guarantee of uninterrupted availability. The provider is not liable for indirect damages arising from use or inability to use the service, to the extent permitted by law.

termsSections.heading: 8. Data protection
termsSections.body: Processing of personal data is governed by the Privacy Policy, which forms part of these terms.

termsSections.heading: 9. Governing law
termsSections.body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. Any dispute will be subject to the applicable courts under consumer-protection rules.

termsSections.heading: 10. Changes
termsSections.body: These terms may be updated; material changes will be communicated to active users by email.

privacySections.heading: 1. Data controller
privacySections.body: Javier Abad, sole trader (autónomo), tax ID 545563340r, registered address at c/ Uria nº8 2ºa, 33202, Oviedo, Spain. Contact for privacy matters: contact@weeklyfeedback.com. There is no designated Data Protection Officer; requests are handled directly by the data controller.

privacySections.heading: 2. What data we process
privacySections.body: From whoever creates the account: email and password (managed by Supabase Auth). About the team: team name, company context, and for each member: name and contact (email, phone, or Telegram chat_id). About weekly replies: the text (or transcription, if sent as a voice note) of what each person answers. About billing: payment details are processed directly by Stripe — this service never stores card numbers.

privacySections.heading: 3. Purpose
privacySections.body: To provide the contracted service: generate the weekly report, deliver it to the team lead, and manage the account and subscription.

privacySections.heading: 4. Legal basis
privacySections.body: Performance of the service contract (GDPR art. 6.1.b). For team members' replies, whoever creates the account is responsible for having a legitimate basis to process that data with respect to their own team.

privacySections.heading: 5. Who we share data with
privacySections.body: The following providers process data as processors, each only with the data they need for their function: Supabase (database, authentication and file storage, servers in the European Union), Stripe (payment processing), Resend (transactional email delivery), Telegram (messaging channel for those who choose it), and Groq (AI report generation from reply text — US-based provider; the transfer relies on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses). We do not sell or share data with third parties for advertising purposes.

privacySections.heading: 6. Retention
privacySections.body: Data is kept while the account is active, plus the additional period required by tax or commercial regulations after cancellation. You can request earlier deletion by writing to the privacy contact.

privacySections.heading: 7. Your rights
privacySections.body: Anyone can exercise their rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to contact@weeklyfeedback.com. You may also file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es) if you believe your rights haven't been addressed.

privacySections.heading: 8. Minors
privacySections.body: The service is aimed at businesses and is not intended for minors.

privacySections.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
privacySections.body: This policy may be updated to reflect changes to the service or applicable regulations; the last-updated date appears at the top of the document.

TelegramHelp.title: How to set up Telegram
TelegramHelp.intro: Linking Telegram is a single step: whoever manages your team adds you in WeeklyFeedback and sends you a personal link — you just open it.
steps: Ask whoever manages your team to add you as a member with the Telegram channel (they don't need any Telegram info from you yet).
They'll see a "Link Telegram" button on your profile — ask them to send you that link (WhatsApp, email, whatever's easiest).
Open it from your phone or desktop with Telegram installed, and tap "Start" in the chat that opens.
That's it — no need to message any other bot or hand over any numbers.
TelegramHelp.note: Once linked, you'll get the weekly reminder straight in that chat and can reply there, with text or a voice note.

HowItWorks.title: The weekly summary, step by step
HowItWorks.intro: Nothing to install, no new account for your team to create. Here's the full cycle, start to finish.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: You create your account, set up one or more teams, and add each person with their email or WhatsApp. No one on the team needs to sign up or install anything — being on the list is enough to get the weekly reminder. You choose the day and time it's sent, and the language of the questions.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: On the day you pick, each person gets three short questions over email or WhatsApp. They can reply right there, from the email or straight in the chat, with no dashboard to log into and no password to remember.
HowItWorks.question1: 1️⃣ What did you do this week?
HowItWorks.question2: 2️⃣ What will you do next week?
HowItWorks.question3: 3️⃣ Anything blocked, or that you need from someone?
HowItWorks.step2Note: Email or WhatsApp: you choose the channel when you add each person.
HowItWorks.step3Title: 3. AI writes the report — nothing invented
HowItWorks.step3Desc: As soon as the team replies, an AI model turns those loose answers into a narrative report you can read in one go. If someone answers short or vague, that part of the report stays short too — honest and brief beats invented filler. It also checks the team's last few reports to flag when a blocker keeps coming back week after week.
HowItWorks.step4Title: 4. It lands as a PDF, branded
HowItWorks.step4Desc: The report is delivered as a PDF attachment by email to whoever you choose — the team lead, leadership, whoever needs it. It's also saved in your dashboard, with the full history of every week and who answered and who didn't.
HowItWorks.step5Desc: If your company has several teams (Organization or Custom plan), each one still gets its own weekly report — and you can also turn on an executive summary that pulls together what matters from all of them: a short paragraph per team, blockers that cross several teams, and the 2-3 most urgent things that week. It goes to whoever leads the company, without anyone losing their own report.
HowItWorks.step6Desc: You can also turn on an anonymous monthly survey with up to 5 questions of your own — answers aren't stored linked to who sent them, not even at the database level, so feedback stays honest.
HowItWorks.securityDesc: Everything is stored in Supabase with European servers. Never shared or sold to anyone. Cancel anytime from your dashboard — no cancellation call, no fine print.
HowItWorks.faq1Q: Does my team need to install anything or create an account?
HowItWorks.faq1A: No. They get the question over email or WhatsApp, reply from there, done. The only account that exists is yours, to manage teams and see the reports.
HowItWorks.faq2Q: What happens if someone doesn't reply that week?
HowItWorks.faq2A: The report is still generated from whoever did reply, and the dashboard clearly shows who was left without an answer that week.
HowItWorks.faq3Q: Can I change the three questions?
HowItWorks.faq3A: The three weekly check-in questions are fixed — designed to get a short, useful answer with no friction. The anonymous monthly survey (Organization/Custom plan) is the one you write yourself, up to 5 questions.
HowItWorks.faq4Q: What if my company has several departments?
HowItWorks.faq4A: You create one team per department, each with its own schedule and its own report. With the Organization or Custom plan you can also turn on the executive summary that pulls them all together.

HowItWorks.ctaDesc: 30 days free. Cancel whenever you want.
